intent: Reproduce the vendor Form preset "String Twist 1" (Lines); reference thumbnail: none shipped

iterations.critique: The render has a convincing String Twist appearance: many fine mint/cyan parallel strings form a broad, symmetric pinched wave against clean black, with clear twist crossings at both side edges. However, frames 1 and 4 are visually identical, so the preset currently has no observable motion. A String Twist preset should read as flowing/twisting rather than as a completely frozen string lattice.

The still design strongly reads as a String Twist: thin luminous mint/cyan lines form a clean, broad symmetric wave, pinch tightly at the left and right twist nodes, and sit well against black. However, t1 and t4 remain visually identical. The attempted Flow X animation is not producing any observable deformation or travel, leaving the result frozen rather than behaving like an animated Form preset.

The result now has clear temporal change, but the motion is far too violent and unstable for a polished String Twist preset. At t1, the mint particle strings form recognizable looping/twisting waves on black. By t4, the coherent string structure has largely collapsed into a dense, noisy particle field with only a thin central oscillation remaining. The desired flowing twist should preserve the legible parallel strings while their pinch points and waves travel smoothly.

The mint-on-black string treatment is clean and attractive, and both frames retain recognizable curved parallel strands with bright pinch crossings. Motion is now observable, but it is still too fast and morphing: frame 1 has two broad, spacious twist lobes, while frame 4 has several tightly repeated lobes and extra dotted/crossing strands. That reads as abrupt structural reconfiguration rather than a smooth traveling String Twist. The animation should keep the same sparse, legible string lattice while the existing twist nodes drift gently.

The render convincingly reads as a polished String Twist preset: fine luminous mint/cyan parallel strings form broad, clean sinusoidal lobes with crisp twist-pinches against black. Crucially, the two frames preserve the same sparse, coherent lattice while the pinch nodes and wave contours shift smoothly, creating controlled flowing motion rather than the prior unstable reconfiguration.
